scope: Funded executor infrastructure only, in-process Ganache31339/shanghai. Engine and facts are deliberately mutable mocks; one integration case uses the real strict word codec.

checks.name: deployment pins dependency code, identities, schema and tokenizer domain
opening binds the caller, exact on-chain facts and canonical prompt to an executor-owned engine request
any no-code address including zero is accepted, while a changed expected target hash fails closed
input bounds and bad adapter data cannot open an injected or malformed model prompt
engine begin must produce a live request owned by the executor
bounded batching advances real engine calls and preserves inspectable Select boundaries
no engine progress or failed engine calls earn no reward and roll back all effects
fee ceiling and remaining-budget reserve pause work without exceeding the deposit
only the owner can top up and cancel; expiry prevents further charged inference
final report decodes only actual terminal engine tokens and settles exactly once
bad EOS, special or out-of-range tokens are rejected without a template fallback
the real strict word codec receives terminal EOS and decodes exact generated engine tokens
codec failure, empty output and oversized output never publish substitute analysis
unused completed budget is credited once to its owner and never to a caller-selected recipient
worker rewards are pull credits; rejected withdrawals preserve credits and reentrancy cannot double-spend
an engine callback cannot enter the executor again or claim unearned work
dependency bytecode and identity changes fail closed before charging further work
owner cancellation refunds the exact unspent balance even after engine code has changed
